note: One page per section example: /sections/<company>-<kind>-<n> (e.g. /sections/rig-ai-hero-1 = 'Hero section from rig.ai'). The element comes from its own position in the template, so a company slug can never inject a second element (wist-chat-hero-1 is hero only). Id and name are the whole captured segment: sectionmaster-com/rig-ai-hero-1 / 'Rig Ai Hero 1', independent of sitemap order. Sections whose kind is not a taxonomy element (about, other, portfolio, contacts …) do not match and are dropped; /inspiration/<element> (11) are kind pages that list examples, not examples themselves.
